steps.en: Officer opens the unclaimed reminders page in the staff portal
steps.id: Staf membuka halaman reminder yang tidak diterima di portal staf

steps.en: Officer uploads the notice numbers of returned reminders
steps.id: Staf mengunggah nomor notice dari reminder yang dikembalikan

steps.en: Officer records why the reminder came back
System temporarily suspends the notice under the unclaimed code
steps.id: Sistem menyuspend notice sementara dengan kode unclaimed

steps.en: System can identify these suspended notices for further checks
steps.id: Sistem dapat mengenali notice yang disuspend ini untuk pengecekan lanjutan
